purpose: Deployable bundle: run trend engine (v1.8) first to produce Bull/Bear, then apply neutral override (neutral_v1.1 profit chase) to optionally return Neutral/Invalid. Engine JSON should remain locked; neutral can be iterated independently.

payout_and_wager.note: P/L simulation uses WIN_MULT and LOSS_MULT and MAX_WAGER from runtime; production deployment may wire to live platform payout.

locked_components.engine_locked_sha_note: Engine v1.8 is to remain unchanged; all future risk/coverage tuning should be done in neutral JSON.

engine.purpose: Recovered locked method: v1.7 base engine + trap stack (1,2,3,5,6B,7 best) producing ~12.7449 net P/L on expanded CSV under v1.6 payout. This is the canonical recovered evaluation baseline.

global_assumptions.sampling: Use tick OCHLV sampled ~2.5s; decision_close is last tick close at or before decision_time.
global_assumptions.gaussian_smoothing: Causal one-sided Gaussian kernel k=0..ceil(4σ), w[k]=exp(-0.5*(k/σ)^2); normalized; apply convolution and edge-correct by partial-sum normalization for first L points.

rules.description: Epoch is INVALID if tick_count_last_epoch < 85 (or missing).
Epoch is INVALID if any required lookback window for features is unavailable (e.g., beginning of file).
Epoch is INVALID if required primitives (decision_close, epoch timing, required sigma series inputs) are missing/NaN.

derived_metrics.spread_primary: spread_s = max(S20,S23,S26) - min(S20,S23,S26); bins by dataset quantiles (q50,q80) => tight/mid/shear

embedded.name: gaussian_v1_7_locked
notes: Start from v1.6A base pred/conf_core after validity gate.
Compute causal Gaussians on per-epoch startPrice series; slopes are first differences.
Apply macro override only when strong context + secondary alignment (and optionally micro confirmation on boundary epochs).
Apply confidence damping/boost; no additional neutrals beyond validity gate.

trap1.description: Weak InsideRun bull with micro disagree + sufficient negative a_band -> flip to Bear.

conditions.note: thr1 = median of (-a_band) over eligible rows where (-a_band)>0, computed per dataset run

trap2.description: Bull with micro_bull + bullish context but strong negative band acceleration => bear trap flip.

trap3.description: Bull with positive S23 but strong negative A23 (deceleration) => flip to Bear.

trap5.description: Bull with bullish context + S23>0 but inverted primary order plus micro slope turning down => flip.

trap6b.description: Weak InsideRun bull while context is bearish and both band accel + micro accel are negative enough => flip.

trap7.description: Weak InsideRun bull in bullish context with band slope positive and S23>0; if band accel and micro accel are negative enough and (spread tight OR A23 very negative) => flip.

parameters.t_a237_definition: t_a237 = quantile_q of (-A23) over broad7 rows where broad7: valid & pred==Bull & InsideRun & Weak & ctx_sign==bull_ctx & s_band>0 & S23>0 & A23<0; clamp (-A23) to >=0 before quantile.

confidence_and_wager.note: If you are only using direction (Bull/Bear), you may ignore this section. Included to reproduce P/L studies.

payout_model.win_profit_multiplier: Use runtime win multiplier (2.0 - 0.08 = 1.92 profit on wager) OR the stored runtime value if present.
payout_model.loss_multiplier: Use runtime loss multiplier (-1.0 - 0.03 = -1.03 profit on wager) OR the stored runtime value if present.
payout_model.fees: 8% on win, 3% on loss, none on neutral

steps: 1) Build decision_close series: for each epoch, decision_time = NextEpochTime - 15s, decision_close is last tick close at or before decision_time.
2) Apply validity gate v1.0: mark epoch invalid if tick_count<85, missing primitives, or insufficient history for lookbacks.
3) Compute causal Gaussian curves Gσ for all required σ using the one-sided kernel and edge-correction.
4) Compute Sσ and Aσ (first/second differences), then compute band and context aggregates (s_band, a_band, ctx_s).
5) Run base engine exactly as in embedded gaussian_v1_7_locked.json to produce base direction and confidence.
6) Apply traps 1→7 in order; each trap may flip Bull→Bear (never Bear→Bull).
7) (Optional) Convert confidence to wager and compute P/L using the payout model.
reproducibility_checks: Verify counts of valid/invalid epochs match your reference run.
Verify Gaussian edge-correction: first L points use partial-sum normalization.
Verify trap thresholds (thr1 and t_a237) are recomputed per dataset run using the stated quantiles.

reference_metrics.dataset: expanded CSV (new) with validity gate v1.0 applied (ticks>=85); trades=8778

neutral.purpose: Secondary neutral override layer to pair with gaussian_v1_7a_locked. Runs AFTER v1.7a produces Bull/Bear (or Invalid). May override Bull/Bear -> Neutral under specific low-edge/uncertainty conditions. Does NOT change labels to the opposite side.

inputs_required: decision_close series and derived Gaussian signals used by v1.7a
execution_order: 1) If base_pred is Neutral or Invalid -> pass-through (no change).
2) If is_valid==False -> force Invalid (or Neutral) per your runtime convention.
3) Evaluate neutral rules in order; first triggered rule sets final_pred=Neutral and stops.

derived.spread_primary: spread_s = max(S20,S23,S26) - min(S20,S23,S26); bins by dataset quantiles (q50,q80) => tight/mid/shear

N1_low_confidence.description: If v1.7a confidence is too low for the predicted side, override to Neutral.

N2_plateau_flat_slope.description: Detect plateau/near-flat movement: tight spread + small |S23| and small |s_band| and weak curvature.

N3_micro_context_disagree_low_edge.description: If micro and context disagree with the base direction AND edge is small (low slope/curvature), neutralize.

N4_primary_squeeze_uncertain.description: If the primary band is squeezed (tight spread) and order is mixed (not clearly aligned/inverted), treat as uncertain and neutralize when edge is modest.

N5_exhaustion_neutral.description: Exhaustion: direction still positive/negative but curvature is strongly opposing (deceleration) while spread is tight -> could be reversal/whipsaw; neutralize.

how_to_use: Load gaussian_v1_7a_locked.json and compute base_pred and conf (and any intermediate features already computed for traps).
Compute the signals listed above (you already have them in v1.7a runtime).
Apply this neutral layer exactly as described in integration_contract.
Log override_reason whenever a rule triggers so we can tune thresholds by bucket.
tuning_plan: Sweep bull_conf_neutral_min and bear_conf_neutral_min for profit/drawdown trade-off.
Tune plateau thresholds (s23_abs_max, sband_abs_max, aband_abs_max) by searching for graph5-like plateau epochs.
Tune exhaustion threshold a23_exhaust_min by targeting remaining flip-start bull-loss buckets.
